name: KitchenAid® Over-the-Range Convection Microwave with Air Fry Mode

productFeature.description: For bake and roast use a 1600-watt convection element to reach temperatures up to 450°F, giving this microwave the ability to convect cook everything from small-batch bakes to a whole roast chicken.
productFeature.title: Convection Cooking Modes

productFeature.description:
Uses dual heating elements and a fan to circulate hot air around the included air fry basket, crisping and browning food with less oil* and no need to preheat.

*When compared to deep frying.
productFeature.title: Air Fry Mode with Included Basket

productFeature.description: Uses the included basket and a 1500-watt grill element in the top of the microwave to sear meats, broil veggies and more.
productFeature.title: Grill Mode

productFeature.description:
Keep your kitchen smelling like home with the 6-Speed, 400 CFM* Motor Class Hood Vent that helps remove smoke, odor and moisture.

*Peak performance varies based on installation. Resources available at aham.org.
productFeature.title: 6-Speed Hood Vent

productFeature.description: Cooks quickly to boil water, defrost ingredients or warm completed dishes to enjoy again.
productFeature.title: 1,200 Watts of Microwave Cooking Power

productFeature.description: Make it easy to steam vegetables and seafood or simmer rice and pasta. Just add water to the included steamer container and select what you're making. When a sensor detects the water is boiling, it will start counting down the ideal cook time.
productFeature.title: Sensor Steam and Simmer Modes

productFeature.description: Uses the power of steam and added water to help loosen cooked-on food without the need for harsh chemical cleaners. After running this cycle, give the inside of the microwave a wipe down with a damp cloth.
productFeature.title: Steam Cleaning Function

productFeature.description: Automatically adjust the time needed to cook, reheat or defrost your food, removing the guesswork about power levels or cooking times.
productFeature.title: Sensor Functions

productFeature.description: Comfortably fits a variety of dishes with enough height for a mixing bowl and width for a 9" x 13" casserole dish.
productFeature.title: 1.9 Cu. Ft. Capacity

productFeature.description: Holds the microwave at 10% cooking power to keep cooked foods at serving temperature, allowing you to focus on other steps in your creative process or finish one dish while another rests.
productFeature.title: Keep Warm Function

productFeature.description: Will automatically rotate while the microwave is in use or can be turned off to accommodate rectangular dishes that are too large to turn.
productFeature.title: Dishwasher-Safe Turntable with On/Off Option

productFeature.description: Help remove the grease and odors of high-heat cooking. Their stainless steel design is dishwasher safe for easy cleaning.
productFeature.title: Dishwasher-Safe Stainless Steel Baffle Filters

productFeature.description: Accented with KitchenAid's signature medallions and detailing, the handle elevates this microwave's aesthetics and perfectly complements your other kitchen appliances, while allowing you to open the door easily.
productFeature.title: Premium Handle Design

productFeature.description: Makes it easy to wipe the interior of the microwave clean with a soft, damp cloth.
productFeature.title: CookShield™ Finish

productFeature.description: Illuminate both the inside of the microwave and the cooking surface below with bright light, so you can easily see what's cooking.
productFeature.title: Halogen Cavity Lights and Task Light
